Name: JEBlock
Author: Vibe Code
Punchline: Jump/Emote Block (JEBlock) complements Gagspeak. Lock your partner into an emote without forcing HARDCORE mode.
Description: When using Triggers or Puppeteer for emotes, your partner can escape by tapping jump or performing a new /emote. This plugin blocks those actions when a specified Loci status effect is detected. You can only escape by moving your character, which may be denied or locked by the restriction from Gagspeak.
